purpose: Document-family coverage planning for BenefitStep CalFresh/Medi-Cal workflows; not the complete official BenefitsCal taxonomy or a mandatory upload checklist.
notes: Only pay_statement has a dedicated trained label corresponding to a specific family here. invoice_or_receipt is broad; other_document is not fine-grained recognition. Unknown is abstention.
Schema support does not establish recognition or extraction accuracy for realistic documents. Native AI evaluation remains pending; local label parsing supports limited explicit English cues.
Scenario mention counts overlap: a request comparison includes both paystub and county_request. Kind aliases do not prove all subtypes are supported.
The 26 planning families and 26 previously catalogued future scenarios are different counts and have no one-to-one relationship.
New source review supports this coverage plan only; it does not change the historical 13-source research count.
